about_the_game:
Welcome to Dog World

Dog World is a game about walking dogs, where a walk can quickly become a test of control and awareness.

In Dog World, you step into the role of a dog walker and oftentimes walking your dog is not just about moving from point A to point B. Your goal is to guide your dog through the environment, allowing it to do the things dogs naturally want to do — explore, investigate, and interact — while keeping it safe from the dangers of the street.

Dogs will follow where you lead them, but the world does not always cooperate.

Along the way, you’ll encounter various characters, unexpected situations, and events that can quickly turn a simple walk into a challenge. Not everyone you meet has good intentions, and some things… are better avoided.

As you progress, you’ll:

  • Walk dogs of different breeds, each with their own unique traits,

  • Manage risk while navigating streets, alleys, and parks,

  • Interact with characters and events that can affect the outcome of a walk,

  • Balance career and responsibility as a professional dog walker,

Dog World gradually expands beyond individual walks, introducing story elements, recurring characters, and long-term consequences tied to your actions.

What starts as a job becomes something more. Not every walk ends the same way.

Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 Mojave or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or dedicated GPU with at least 2GB VRAM
  • Storage: At least 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable internet connection for initial download and updates
